Sergio / team — draft technical responses below. I've focused on the specific marketplace sections Luke called out. Please review and edit for tone/commercial where appropriate.

1) Tenant isolation / deployment models- Hosted (Redwood API, hosted): multi-tenant runtime with strict logical tenant isolation, per-tenant namespaces, encrypted KV caches.
- Dedicated (Redwood Dedicated): reserved GPU pools per customer, network isolation via private subnets; supports VPC peering and PrivateLink-style endpoints for AWS, and equivalent private endpoint connectors for Azure/GCP.
- Private (Redwood Private): on-prem or VPC-deployed control plane; customer-managed networking and optional air-gapped images.

2) Marketplace metering / usage reporting- Metering units: we expose both token-based and request-based metering primitives. For marketplace integrations we can emit metering events mapped to SKU granularities (e.g., generation_tokens, embedding_units, conversation_sessions).
- Reporting: integration options include direct marketplace metering APIs (Marketplace Metering Service for AWS, Azure Marketplace metering APIs, GCP Marketplace metering), or CSV/POST reporting for marketplaces that require batched reports.
- Reconciliation: we provide per-tenant usage reports (daily) and an aggregated monthly report useful for invoice reconciliation.

3) Commercial / billing flows (marketplace specifics)- Private offers: supported. For AWS Private Offers / Azure Private Plans / GCP Private Catalog we can accept private-offer commitments and coordinate invoice flow.
- Third-party billing: we support both marketplace-managed billing (charges via the marketplace invoice) and direct-billing options (Redwood invoices StratusBank directly and reports usage to marketplace for listing visibility).
- Entitlements/SKUs: we can model SKUs for reserved capacity, metered usage (token/embedding), and add-ons (priority support, extended retention). We will provide a SKU manifest that maps internal product features to marketplace SKUs.

4) Marketplace listing artifacts and required evidence- Typical artifacts: product description, icons/screenshots, pricing table, support contacts, private offer contract template, technical FAQ, and deployment diagrams.
- Certifications/evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), penetration test summary, data processing addendum (DPA), ISO 27001 certificate (if requested). We'll attach redacted versions for procurement review.

5) Data residency & region controls- We support region-specific model serving by pinning model execution to region-specific GPU pools. Customers can request regional-only deployments for EU/US/APAC. For strict residency, we offer Private deployments inside customer VPC or on-prem.

6) Operational telemetry & support SLAs- Telemetry: per-request tracing IDs, per-token latency & cost breakdowns, and per-route dashboards available in the Redwood Console.
- Support: standard SLAs available on Dedicated/Private contracts; Marketplace listings can optionally include premium SLA entitlements as an add-on.

Attachments: technical-diagram-vpc.png (diagram), RBW-Marketplace-RFI-answers-draft.docx

-- Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer, Infra & Marketplace Integrations
